name: Multiorders
description_en:
Multiorders combines multichannel inventory, order management and shipping for ecommerce sellers. It connects listings to a shared stock view and provides document generation, shipping automation and FBA/MCF-related workflows.

The key inventory task is mapping identical products and bundles across channels so that a sale changes the right underlying quantity. Shipping labels and unlimited integrations do not by themselves prove that every marketplace exception is handled.
description_zh:
Multiorders 为电商卖家组合多渠道库存、订单管理和运输，将刊登连接到共享库存视图，并提供单据、运输自动化及 FBA/MCF 相关流程。

库存核心任务是跨渠道映射相同商品和套装，确保销售扣减正确的底层数量。可打印标签和集成不限并不能证明所有市场例外均已处理。

core_features.explanation_en: The inventory page says selling a bundle deducts each component individually.
core_features.explanation_zh: 库存页说明售出套装时逐项扣减组件。

core_features.explanation_en: The plan feature list includes order automation/merge, shipping automation and bulk shipping.
core_features.explanation_zh: 方案列表包含订单自动化及合并、运输自动化和批量发货。

Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Check a bundle sold on two channels
sections.title_zh: 核查跨两渠道销售套装
sections.en: Connect a store and marketplace, merge equivalent product records and define a bundle’s components. Sell the bundle and then a component separately, inspecting channel quantities after both events. Include a variation and a return. Multiorders documents shared stock updates and low-stock alerts; actual update latency and last-unit race handling were not measured.
sections.zh: 连接网店与市场，合并等价商品记录并定义套装组件。先销售套装再单独销售组件，检查两次事件后的渠道数量，另加入变体和退货。Multiorders 描述共享数量更新及低库存提醒，但实际延迟和最后一件商品并发处理未测量。

sections.title_en: Prefer the dedicated price page and flag conflicts
sections.title_zh: 优先独立价格页并标记冲突
sections.en: The dedicated pricing page lists USD monthly Pro 500/1K/2K/5K at $64/$129/$195/$299 and annual totals $640/$1,290/$1,950/$2,990, with 500/1,000/2,000/5,000 monthly orders. GBP has its own rates. The inventory landing page contains different annual amounts and a $49 starting headline, so those pages conflict. Confirm checkout currency and current tariff rather than blending old and new tables.
sections.zh: 独立价格页列出 Pro 500/1K/2K/5K 美元月付 $64/$129/$195/$299，年总额 $640/$1,290/$1,950/$2,990，对应每月 500/1,000/2,000/5,000 订单，英镑另有费率。库存落地页年价不同且标题写 $49 起，存在冲突。应确认结账币种和现行价，不能混用不同表格。

sections.title_en: Unlimited users does not remove order limits
sections.title_zh: 用户不限不代表订单不限
sections.en: All plans advertise unlimited users, products, sales-channel connections and shipping integrations. Monthly order allowances still drive the selected tier. The FAQ says unused orders do not carry into an upgraded allowance. Verify how canceled, merged, historical and manually created orders count before selecting capacity.
sections.zh: 所有方案宣传用户、商品、销售渠道连接和运输集成不限，但月订单额度仍决定档位。FAQ 表示升级时未使用订单不结转。应确认取消、合并、历史导入和手工订单如何计数。

sections.title_en: Plan for paused synchronization when the trial ends
sections.title_zh: 为试用到期后的同步暂停做准备
sections.en: The no-card trial lasts 14 days. The FAQ states order imports and quantity/product updates pause at trial end; purchase within 14 days resumes them, while after that window syncing does not resume automatically. Subscription billing is prepaid, with a stated 14-day paid-upgrade refund window. A merchant should resolve conversion timing before depending on live stock updates.
sections.zh: 无需信用卡的试用为 14 天。FAQ 说明到期后订单导入及数量、商品更新暂停；14 天内购买可恢复，之后同步不会自动恢复。订阅预付，并注明升级付费后 14 天退款窗口。依赖线上库存更新前应明确转付费时点。
